packageRules.description: Pin Docker base images to a digest and keep the digest current, since the Dockerfile's oven/bun, golang, alpine, and linuxserver/unrar images all use floating tags.
Group all golang.org/x/* module updates into a single PR.

customManagers.description: Tracks the animetosho/par2cmdline-turbo release pinned by ARG PAR2_VERSION in the Dockerfile (downloaded via its GitHub release tarball URL) — Dependabot has no equivalent capability for a version pinned inside an ARG line.
